comment: D474 §5.1 / C7: the one 48 h rule for a reserve item that expires soon (the reserve line's amber clause, the counted reserve alert, the widget card, the menu). The page helper (desktop/cockpit/study/rocket-r1/reserve-expiry.js) and the native helper (#1289, ReserveExpiry) are tested against these cases. `now` is fixed; `expiresAt` is an ISO time or null; `soon` is the answer.
